name: Import Data from File
description: Upload and import data from CSV or Excel files

steps.title: Navigate to Import Tool
steps.description: Go to the Data menu and select Import Data.

steps.title: Choose File Type
steps.description: Select the type of file you want to import (CSV, Excel, JSON).

steps.title: Upload File
steps.description: Click the Upload button and select your file from your computer.

steps.title: Map Columns
steps.description: Match the columns in your file to the corresponding fields in the system.

steps.title: Preview Data
steps.description: Review the data preview to ensure it looks correct before importing.

steps.title: Start Import
steps.description: Click the Import button to begin processing the data.

steps.title: Monitor Progress
steps.description: Watch the progress bar and wait for the import to complete.
